extracted.name: Zombie cocktail
extracted.description: Blend white and dark rum with lime juice, pineapple juice and a splash of grenadine to make this ghoulish Halloween cocktail. Garnish with cherries and mint
ingredient_lines: 25ml dark rum (or a mixture of dark rum and golden rum)
25ml white rum (or a mixture of white rum and overproof rum)
instruction_lines: Pour the rums and fruit juices into a cocktail shaker filled with ice and shake hard until the outside of the shaker feels really cold.
Strain the mixture into a tall glass or hurricane glass filled with ice, then slowly pour in the grenadine to colour the drink.
Skewer the orange wedge and cherries on a cocktail stick. Garnish the drink with mint sprigs and the skewered fruit.
